passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I can swim, and I can also sing a little.
phrases.ko: 나는 수영할 수 있고, 노래도 조금 부를 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 我会游泳，也会唱一点歌。
phrases.py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng， yě huì chàng yì diǎn gē。

phrases.en: I like to draw pictures of animals.
phrases.ko: 나는 동물 그림을 그리는 것을 좋아해요.
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān huà dòng wù。

phrases.en: I can run fast when I play with my friends.
phrases.ko: 친구들과 놀 때 나는 빨리 달릴 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 和朋友玩的时候，我能跑得很快。
phrases.py: hé péng yǒu wán de shí hòu， wǒ néng pǎo de hěn kuài。

phrases.en: I play the piano at home in the evening.
phrases.py: bàng wǎn wǒ zài jiā tán gāng qín。

phrases.en: I like to read a story at night.
phrases.ko: 나는 밤에 이야기를 읽는 것을 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢晚上读一个故事。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān wǎn shàng dú yí gè gù shì。

phrases.en: My little sister listens when I sing.
phrases.zh: 我唱歌的时候，妹妹会听。
phrases.py: wǒ chàng gē de shí hòu， mèi mèi huì tīng。

phrases.en: She is eleven, and she likes my stories.
phrases.ko: 동생은 열한 살이고, 내 이야기를 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 她十一岁，喜欢我的故事。
phrases.py: tā shí yī suì， xǐ huān wǒ de gù shì。

phrases.en: I can help her with a short story.
phrases.ko: 나는 짧은 이야기로 동생을 도와줄 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 我可以用一个短故事帮助她。
phrases.py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng yí gè duǎn gù shì bāng zhù tā。

phrases.en: I draw, I run, and I swim because they make me happy.
phrases.ko: 나는 그림을 그리고, 달리고, 수영해요. 그러면 행복해져요.
phrases.zh: 我画画、跑步、游泳，因为这些让我快乐。
phrases.py: wǒ huà huà、 pǎo bù、 yóu yǒng， yīn wèi zhè xiē ràng wǒ kuài lè。

phrases.en: At night I play the piano a little.
phrases.zh: 晚上我再练一会儿钢琴。
phrases.py: wǎn shàng wǒ zài liàn yī huì er gāng qín。

phrases.en: This is more about me, and I am glad to tell you.
phrases.ko: 이것이 나에 대한 이야기이고, 말해 주어서 기뻐요.
phrases.zh: 这是更多关于我的事，我很高兴告诉你。
phrases.py: zhè shì gèng duō guān yú wǒ de shì， wǒ hěn gāo xìng gào sù nǐ。

full_passage_spoken: I can swim, and I can also sing a little. I like to draw pictures of animals. I can run fast when I play with my friends. I play the piano at home in the evening. I like to read a story at night. My little sister listens when I sing. She is eleven, and she likes my stories. I can help her with a short story. I draw, I run, and I swim because they make me happy. At night I play the piano a little. This is more about me, and I am glad to tell you.
full_passage_zh: 我会游泳，也会唱一点歌。我喜欢画动物。和朋友玩的时候，我能跑得很快。傍晚我在家弹钢琴。我喜欢晚上读一个故事。我唱歌的时候，妹妹会听。她十一岁，喜欢我的故事。我可以用一个短故事帮助她。我画画、跑步、游泳，因为这些让我快乐。晚上我再练一会儿钢琴。这是更多关于我的事，我很高兴告诉你。
